profile.headline: Formerly Incarcerated | Software Engineer @ Disney | Founder, Firme Coding | MBA, Cal Poly Pomona
profile.summary:
I'm Maria Martinez, a formerly incarcerated software engineer, nonprofit founder, and unapologetic advocate for justice-impacted talent in tech.
 
At Disney, I build internal developer tools, including MCP servers and agent tooling, that streamline workflows and make the developer experience not just more efficient, but a little more magical.
 
Beyond the magic, I founded and lead Firme Coding, a nonprofit creating pathways into tech for people impacted by incarceration. We teach digital literacy, AI fundamentals, critical thinking, and SwiftUI, and our fellows learn to build AI agents and ship real software. The goal is to move forward with confidence, whether that means advancing into programs like Columbia's Justice Through Code, landing paid internships, or launching community-rooted tech ventures.
 
From debugging Cypress tests to pitching equity-centered solutions to funders, everything I build comes back to one belief: brilliance already exists in our communities. It just needs the opportunity to shine.
 
If you care about second chances, tech for good, or building systems that create real access, let's connect.

Accomplishments
•	Fall 2019, I put together our first Transfer Empowerment event. projects.title: Vanilla JS Weather App
projects.description:
Implemented a search engine, API integration, unit conversion, wind speed, precipitation, weather description, weather icon based on location, and a forecast report for three-hour intervals.

Also, hosted my project on Netlfiy using my GitHub repository.
